directions: In this task, you are to write an essay on the importance of developing a healthy lifestyle among college students. You will have 30 minutes for the task. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
sample_essay:
Developing a healthy lifestyle is of utmost importance for college students. To begin with, a healthy lifestyle helps students maintain physical well-being. Regular exercise, such as jogging or playing basketball, can strengthen the body and reduce the risk of diseases. For example, students who exercise regularly are less likely to catch colds.

In addition, a healthy lifestyle contributes to mental health. Eating a balanced diet and getting enough sleep can improve mood and reduce stress. When students are well-rested and have proper nutrition, they can better cope with the academic pressure. For instance, a student who has a good night's sleep is more likely to be focused in class.

Furthermore, a healthy lifestyle can enhance students' social skills. Participating in group sports or fitness activities provides opportunities to meet new people and make friends. This interaction can improve their communication and cooperation abilities.

In conclusion, college students should pay attention to developing a healthy lifestyle as it benefits their physical health, mental state, and social life.
